answer: A bankruptcy-remote escrow covenant can bind each agent identity to a distinct copper collateral reserve, so a sybil cluster cannot share one balance-sheet facility without triggering a liquidation waterfall that seizes the entire garden of pledged assets. Any new identity must post fresh capital and pass solvency ratio checks, preventing a ripple of fake accounts. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
